narrative:
Brown County has 28,855 registered voters, with 15.2% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 32.6% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 48.5%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 16.0 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.4% of registrants.
